# Slide Blueprint: Breaking Down Successful Photo Retrieval

## 1. Slide Title & Header
* **Slide Title:** `Breaking down successful photo retrieval` (Font: Bold, Google Blue)
* **Header Decorator:** 4-color horizontal accent bar directly beneath the title (Blue, Red, Yellow, Green — signature Google colors).
* **Brand Logo:** Google Photos pinwheel icon in the top right corner.

---

## 2. Layout Structure

* **Overall Canvas:** 16:9 widescreen layout, clean light theme.
* **Top Half (Metrics Containers):** 
  * 3 equal-height rectangular card containers arranged horizontally:
    * **Card 1 (Left - ~33% width):** North Star Metric (with a callout badge).
    * **Card 2 (Center - ~33% width):** Primary Metrics.
    * **Card 3 (Right - ~33% width):** L1 Metrics.
* **Bottom Half (Journey Mapping Grid):**
  * 1 structured table/matrix spanning full width with 3 rows:
    * **Row 1:** User Journey Stages (with directional arrows connecting columns).
    * **Row 2:** User Behaviour.
    * **Row 3:** Desired Product Outcome (Ask/Search Photos).
  * 6 sequential columns representing the end-to-end user experience.
* **Footer:** Slide number (`1`) aligned to the bottom right.

---

## 3. Visual Elements & Styling

* **Color Palette:**
  * **Primary Blue:** `#4285F4` (Title, Metric Headings, Journey Arrows)
  * **Card Fill:** White `#FFFFFF` with subtle outline (`#E0E0E0`) and slight drop shadow.
  * **Background:** Clean White (`#FFFFFF`).
  * **Accents:** Yellow star ribbon badge (`#F4B400`), 4-color line (Blue, Red, Yellow, Green).
  * **Typography:** Clean Sans-serif (Product Sans / Roboto / Arial), standard hierarchy.
* **Icons / Badges:**
  * Yellow shooting star / ribbon icon anchored to the top-left corner of the "North Star Metric" box.
  * Blue horizontal connector arrows (`→`) between stage headers in the journey table.

---

## 4. Content & Text Extraction

### A. Top Section: Metrics Framework

#### Container 1: NORTH STAR METRIC
* **Badge:** Yellow shooting star
* **Header:** `NORTH STAR METRIC`
* **Core Metric:**
  * **% of vaguely remembered photos retrieved successfully**
* **Definition / Qualification:**
  * *Where* Vague memory refers to the photos user cannot confidently describe the exact date, location, or keywords and success defined to be when user confirms they found the intended photo.

---

#### Container 2: PRIMARY METRICS
* **Header:** `PRIMARY METRICS`
* **Bullet Points:**
  * **Retrieval Success Rate:** Tasks where target photo was opened/Total search attempts
  * **Time to Retrieval:** Time taken from starting the search to finding the photo
  * **Repeat Searches:** Number of searches/reformulations before retrieval

---

#### Container 3: L1 METRICS
* **Header:** `L1 METRICS`
* **Bullet Points:**
  * Average number of contextual cues in query
  * Recovery Rate within 3 searches
  * Avg. results viewed before successful retrieval
  * % users switching to manual browsing

---

### B. Bottom Section: Journey & Outcome Mapping Table

| Metric / Dimension | Stage 1 | Stage 2 | Stage 3 | Stage 4 | Stage 5 | Stage 6 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **User journey** *(Connected by `→`)* | **Express Vague Memmory** | **Interpret Intent** | **Scans results** | **Recognize Photo** | **Recover from Failure** | **Retrieve** |
| **User behaviour** | User describes whatever they remember, even if incomplete | User expects Photos to understand their description | User looks through search results | User compares likely photos | User refines the search when the first attempt fails | User opens the intended photo |
| **Desired product outcome (Ask/ Search Photos)** | Capture the user’s contextual clues | Translate the information to relevant results | Relevant photos appear early, with fewer unrelated results | User can quickly identify the intended photo | Photos helps the user narrow the search instead of starting over | Successful retrieval with minimal effort |

# Presentation Slide Blueprint

### 1. Slide Title and Subtitle / Action Header
* **Main Title:** `Secondary Research: Search Finds Words, Not Memories`
  * *Typography:* Large, bold, sans-serif, Google Blue (`#4285F4`).
* **Branding Element:** Standard Google Photos 4-color pinwheel logo in the top-right corner.
* **Accent Divider:** 4-color horizontal bar directly beneath the title (Blue, Red, Yellow, Green).
* **Action Subtitle / Context Header:**
  * `"AI-powered analysis of 1400+ user reviews across various forums Play Store, App Store, Reddit & Support Forums"`
  * *Typography:* Regular weight, dark gray/black, sans-serif.

---

### 2. Layout Structure
* **Canvas:** Standard 16:9 widescreen, clean white background.
* **Top Grid (Split 2 Columns, ~68% / 32% ratio):**
  * **Left Column:** "WHY SEARCH FAILS" — A single large rounded container holding a 5-row structured key-value list.
  * **Right Column:** "KEY SIGNALS" — Vertical stack of 3 individual metric callout cards.
* **Bottom Section (Full Width, 3-Card Grid):**
  * Section title with inline source icons.
  * 3 equal-width rounded cards positioned horizontally side-by-side.
* **Footer Row:**
  * Centered actionable links with icons.
  * Page number aligned to the bottom-right corner.

---

### 3. Content Sections and Exact Headings/Labels

#### Section A: Top Left – `WHY SEARCH FAILS`
* **Container Header:** `WHY SEARCH FAILS` (Uppercase, Google Blue, medium/bold).
* **Row Items (Bold label on left, descriptive explanation on right):**
  1. **Multi-attribute:** Person + place + object searches can flood results with unrelated matches.
  2. **Life-event recall:** Milestones and personal moments are hard to capture from keywords alone.
  3. **False-positive clutter:** Visual lookalikes can overwhelm precise item searches.
  4. **Temporal gap:** Users remember a rough time but struggle to combine it with visual content.
  5. **Text/OCR noise:** Incidental text on signs, receipts or backgrounds can distort results.

#### Section B: Top Right – `KEY SIGNALS`
* **Section Header:** `KEY SIGNALS` (Uppercase, Google Blue, medium/bold).
* **Card 1:**
  * **Metric:** `68%`
  * **Label:** Irrelevant results
* **Card 2:**
  * **Metric:** `42%`
  * **Label:** Clutter occurs in 2+ detail searches
* **Card 3:**
  * **Metric:** `31%`
  * **Label:** Say the photo exists but isn't found

#### Section C: Bottom – `USER VOICE EXTRACTS`
* **Section Header:** `USER VOICE EXTRACTS` (Uppercase, Google Blue) followed by 3 inline platform icons:
  * Apple App Store icon
  * Google Play Store icon
  * Reddit icon
* **Card 1:**
  * **Bold Prompt:** `Searching for daughter in yellow raincoat jumping in puddle in Seattle-`
  * **User Quote:** *“gave me every picture of rain, yellow flowers, and random puddle shots from 10 years of photos”*
* **Card 2:**
  * **Bold Prompt:** `Searching for distinctive colored drink on rooftop at night during Tokyo trip-`
  * **User Quote:** *“Typed 'neon green drink Tokyo rooftop night' and got zero matches. I had to manually scroll through 4,000 photos”*
* **Card 3:**
  * **Bold Prompt:** `Searching for warranty receipt for lawn mower while in store`
  * **User Quote:** *“returned 45 photos of my lawn and street signs with words on them, completely burying the actual scanned receipt”*

#### Section D: Footer
* **Left Link:** 🤿 / 🔭 Binoculars icon + `Live AI Discovery Engine` (Blue, underlined, italicized).
* **Right Link:** 📄 Document icon + `Detailed Report` (Plum/Red-purple, underlined, italicized).
* **Page Number:** `2` (bottom-right).

---

### 4. Visual Elements
* **Cards & Containers:**
  * Rounded rectangle containers with subtle thin gray borders (`#E2E8F0` / `#D1D5DB`) and no drop shadows (flat Google Material style).
* **Metric Callouts:**
  * Extra-large, bold percentage numbers positioned on the left side of small horizontal pill/card containers.
* **Icons:**
  * Google Photos pinwheel logo (Header).
  * Platform logos (App Store, Play Store, Reddit) inline next to bottom section header.
  * Binoculars and Document glyphs in footer links.

---

### 5. Color Palette & Styling
* **Background:** Clean White (`#FFFFFF`).
* **Text Primary:** Charcoal / Dark Gray (`#1F2937`).
* **Google Core Brand Palette:**
  * **Primary Blue:** `#4285F4` (Main title, category headers, 31% stat, primary link).
  * **Coral / Red:** `#EA4335` (68% metric stat).
  * **Amber / Yellow:** `#FBBC04` / `#F59E0B` (42% metric stat).
  * **Green:** `#34A853` (Divider bar).
  * **Secondary Link Color:** Plum / Deep Rose (`#A8325B` / `#B83280`).
* **Corner Radius:** ~8px to 12px on all container cards.

---

### 6. Summary of Key Insights & Takeaways
* **Core Problem:** Keyword-based photo retrieval fails because users search with episodic/semantic memories (multi-attribute, subjective, temporal), while the engine indexes literal labels/OCR noise.
* **Quantified Impact:**
  * **68%** of users experience irrelevant results.
  * **42%** see severe clutter as soon as query complexity exceeds 2 details.
  * **31%** know a specific photo exists but cannot locate it via search.

# Presentation Blueprint: Solution Prioritization (RICE Framework)

### 1. Slide Title & Header
* **Main Title:** `Picking the Solution` (Google Blue, Bold)
* **Title Underline:** Multi-color Google brand bar (Blue, Red, Yellow, Green)
* **Top Right Branding:** Google Photos pinwheel logo
* **Slide Number:** `6` (Bottom-right corner)

---

### 2. Layout Structure
* **Top Half (Two-Column Layout):**
  * **Left Column (~50% width):** Large, prominent rounded container card representing the selected/winning solution.
  * **Right Column (~50% width):** Labeled with section header `"Alternative solutions"`, containing two vertically stacked rounded cards for rejected alternatives.
* **Bottom Half (Data & Legend Layout):**
  * **Left/Center (~75% width):** Prioritization data table (RICE matrix).
  * **Right (~20% width):** Compact rounded callout box defining the RICE scoring scales.

---

### 3. Content Sections & Exact Text

#### A. Winning Solution Card (Left)
* **Badge / Visual Indicator:** Gold Crown icon (top-left)
* **Card Header:** **BETTER SEARCH**  
  *(AI-guided progressive retrieval)* (Deep Blue, Bold, Centered)
* **Section: Steps**
  * Let users describe what they remember
  * AI starts with broad candidates
  * Asks the most useful missing question
  * Progressively narrows results
  * Stops when enough confidence is reached.
* **Section: Features**
  * Dynamic questions based on the current result set
  * Answers become persistent memory chips
  * Users can say “I’m not sure”
  * Stops when enough information is available/ within 5 questions to avoid fatigue
  * Helps users recover without restarting the search
* **Section: Why this solution?**
  * Addresses the full retrieval journey from vague memory to final photo retrieval while reducing repeated searches and manual browsing.

---

#### B. Alternative Solutions (Right Column)
* **Section Label:** `Alternative solutions` (Blue, Bold)

* **Top Card: AI BEST-MATCH RESULTS**
  * **What it is:** AI ranks and groups the most relevant photos at the top of the results.
  * **Why not chosen:** Makes results easier to scan but does not solve the root problem of users being unable to express or refine an incomplete memory.

* **Bottom Card: AI QUERY EXPANSION**
  * **What it is:** AI enriches the user's short query with additional contextual clues before searching.
  * **Why not chosen:** Improves the first search but does not actively help when results remain ambiguous or the user is unsure about their memory.

---

#### C. Bottom Data Section (RICE Scoring Table & Legend)

##### **Prioritization Table**
| Solution | Reach | Impact | Confidence | Effort | RICE Score |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Better Search** *(Highlighted in Red)* | **7** | **3** | **0.90** | **3** | **6.30** |
| AI Query Expansion | 8 | 2 | 0.80 | 3 | 4.27 |
| AI Best-Match Results | 6 | 2 | 0.80 | 4 | 2.40 |

##### **Scale Callout Box (Right of Table)**
* **Header:** **Scale:**
* `Reach = 1-10`
* `Impact = 1-3`
* `Confidence = 0-1`
* `Effort = 1-5`

---

### 4. Visual Elements & Color Accents
* **Background:** Clean solid white.
* **Containers:** Rounded rectangular cards (`border-radius: ~12-16px`) with thin light-grey stroke (`#DADCE0`) and subtle drop shadow.
* **Color Palette:**
  * **Primary Text & Headings:** Deep Google Blue (`#1A73E8` / `#0D47A1`)
  * **Body Text:** Charcoal / Off-black (`#202124` / `#3C4043`)
  * **Highlighted Winner Metrics:** Bright Red/Coral (`#D93025`)
  * **Icon Accents:** Gold/Yellow Crown emoji (`#FBBC04`)
  * **Brand Bar:** Google Blue, Red, Yellow, Green stripe under the title.

# Presentation Slide Blueprint

* **Bottom Right Page Number:** `7`

---

### 2. Layout Structure
* **Overall Structure:** 3-column chronological user flow / storyboard diagram.
* **Flow Direction:** Horizontal left-to-right sequence, connected by directional arrows (`➔`).
* **Column Components (Per Column):**
  * **Top:** Mobile smartphone device mockup displaying the UI/UX interaction state.
  * **Middle:** Blue transition arrow indicating sequence progression between screens.
  * **Bottom:** Rounded rectangular caption callout box explaining the product mechanism at each stage.

### 3. Content Sections & Mockup Breakdown

* **Bottom Callout Box:**
  * **Header:** **Starting the Search –**

---

#### **Column 2: First-Level Refinement (Category/Symptom)**
* **Device Mockup UI:**
  * **Header:** Back arrow, Google Photos logo with badge: `Better Search ✨`, Profile avatar (`P`).
  * **Search Input:** `"Prescription"` with an `✕` clear button.
  * **Filter Pill / Chips:**
    * `✦ Memory: Prescription ✕` (Blue outline chip)
  * **Count Metric:** `130 ➔ 53 matches` (Dim grey to highlighted blue text).
  * **Interactive AI Card ("Better Search"):**
    * Sub-header: `✦ BETTER SEARCH` (Left) | `Step 1 of 5 ●○○○○` (Right, stepper dots)
    * Prompt: **What was the prescription for?**
    * Selection Pills/Buttons:
      * `Vomiting`
      * `Fever`
      * `Cold`
      * `Pain`
      * `Skin`
      * `I'm not sure`

#### **Column 3: Progressive Contextual Refinement (Temporal/Time)**
* **Device Mockup UI:**
  * **Header:** Back arrow, Google Photos logo with badge: `Better Search ✨`, Profile avatar (`P`).
  * **Search Input:** `"Prescription"` with an `✕` clear button.
  * **Filter Pills / Chips:**
    * `✦ Memory: Prescription ✕`
    * `Vomiting ✕` (Second accumulated filter chip)

* **Match Funnel Metrics:**
  * Initial broad volume: **130 matches**
  * After Step 1 (Symptom): **53 matches** (approx. 59% reduction)

### 1. Slide Title & Header
* **Slide Title:** `Measuring the Impact and Risks`
  * **Position:** Top-left aligned

* **Header Decoration:** 4-color horizontal line (Blue, Red, Yellow, Green) positioned directly below the title

### 2. Layout Structure
* **Overall Structure:** 2-column comparison/split layout on a clean white background.
* **Left Column (~45% width):** Single tall card container for quantitative impact sizing.
* **Right Column (~55% width):** 3 vertically stacked card containers for qualitative risk analysis.

---

### 3. Content Sections & Exact Labels

#### Column 1: `IMPACT SIZING`
* **Container:** 1 full-height card with rounded corners and a subtle light-gray border.
* **Content:**
  * • 370M+ people search their photos monthly on Google Photos -the relevant addressable search population.
  * • 75% of surveyed users (n=32) hit the 3-search friction point before finding the photo or giving up.
  * • 64.3% then continue through search refinement or manual browsing, indicating meaningful recovery friction.
  * • **Directional guesstimate:** 370M × 75% ≈ 278M potential users/month facing similar friction, assuming the survey prevalence broadly reflects the wider search population.
  * • **Product opportunity:** Improve retrieval within 3 searches, reducing repeat searches, manual browsing, and time to retrieval.

---

#### Column 2: `RISK & MITIGATION STRATEGIES`
* **Container:** 3 identical rounded-corner cards stacked vertically.

* **Card 1:**
  * **Risk Label (Red/Coral):** `Wrong AI interpretation:`
  * **Risk Description:** AI may misinterpret a vague memory and filter out the correct photo too early.
  * **Mitigation Label (Blue):** `Mitigation:`
  * **Mitigation Description:** Keep the initial 50–55 results broad, preserve multiple candidate paths, and allow users to undo/skip filters.

* **Card 2:**
  * **Risk Label (Red/Coral):** `Too many / Irrelevant AI questions:`
  * **Risk Description:** Asking questions the user cannot remember or doesn't need can add friction and push them back to manual browsing.
  * **Mitigation Label (Blue):** `Mitigation:`
  * **Mitigation Description:** Use dynamic question selection, ask only the highest-value question, support “I’m not sure”, and stop as soon as enough confidence is reached.

* **Card 3:**
  * **Risk Label (Red/Coral):** `Privacy & trust concerns`
  * **Risk Description:** Users may hesitate if AI appears to infer sensitive details or analyze personal photos without clear context.
  * **Mitigation Label (Blue):** `Mitigation:`
  * **Mitigation Description:** Clearly explain what AI is using for retrieval, limit analysis to the search session, avoid exposing sensitive inferences, and provide transparent controls.

---

### 4. Visual Elements & Metrics
* **Key Metrics Highlighted:**
  * `370M+` (Monthly photo search population)
  * `75%` (Surveyed users hitting 3-search friction point, sample `n=32`)
  * `64.3%` (Users continuing via manual recovery/refinement)
  * `278M` (Estimated addressable users experiencing friction: `370M × 75%`)
  * `50–55` (Target initial broad results threshold)
* **Containers:** Rounded rectangular cards (`border-radius: ~12px–16px`, `1px solid #E0E0E0`).
